Each was written by one Sonnet reader from the function alone and confirmed by a second, independent Sonnet reviewer who tried to break it (reviewer note kept); rejected reasons are not here. The statement must equal the current line of the row, else the reason is ignored (scripts/fl41_survivors.py).
